request: Unify every calendar and Android widget with the Schedule tab style contract; replace the separate briefing page with inline calendar briefing; change selected dates to an outline-only selection.

plan.item: Canonical calendar style contract shared by app and widgets
plan.decision: Native month-widget range resources are the versioned canonical geometry. The provider uses setBackgroundResource so start/middle/end seams and caps remain intact; only the single-layer recurring pill is safely runtime-tinted on Android 12+. Any fill or border token change that needs a range shape requires matching checked-in drawable XML before bumping the contract version.

plan.item: Inline morning/evening briefing in Schedule tab
plan.details: The /briefing route opens ShellScreen's calendar tab for today (morning) or tomorrow (evening), suppresses the initial bottom sheet, keeps the existing list visible, and displays a compact top loader while one manual briefing runs. Dispose/mounted cancellation guards prevent stale UI updates.

plan.item: Outline-only selected dates including group calendar
plan.details: Selected cells use a primary outline without overriding semantic event text colors. A selected today keeps its today circle in the group calendar.

plan.item: Focused tests, full Android build, and device visual verification
